welcome.title: Let's learn together
welcome.body: You'll learn to use this app through a few simple exercises. We'll do everything in a separate practice profile. Your real presentations won't be affected, and live output will stay off. Ready? Let's begin!

presentations.title: Presentations
presentations.body: The tools at the top bring together new presentations, files, backups, Drive, and PowerPoint. Below, the current presentation area shows the open presentation’s name and save status and lets you continue editing its slides.

sidebar.title: Getting around the app
sidebar.body: The menu on the left takes you to the app's different sections. Throughout the tutorial, we'll highlight the buttons and areas you need to guide you along.

nav-slides.title: Open the Slides section
nav-slides.body: Let's create our first slide! Click the highlighted Slides button in the left menu.

add.title: Create a new slide
add.body: Click the highlighted New Slide button. A new slide will be added to your presentation.

select.title: Select the sample slide
select.body: Now let's learn how to delete a slide. Click the highlighted sample slide. The slide you just created will be kept.

delete.title: Delete the sample slide
delete.body: To delete the selected sample slide, press Delete or click the highlighted trash icon in the right panel. Use whichever method you prefer!

done.title: Congratulations, you've completed the tutorial!
done.body:
You've explored the app's main features! You've learned to create slides, add content, edit images, and save your presentation.

Your practice changes will be kept when you exit. You're now ready to use the app!

nav-bible.title: Open the Bible section
nav-bible.body: This app makes it easy to add Bible verses to your presentation. Click the highlighted Bible button in the left menu.

bible-intro.title: Explore Bible sources
bible-intro.body: You can import Bible translations from XML files or find and add them using the app's online Bible selection button. In this exercise, we'll use a sample XML file prepared for you.

nav-media.title: Open the Media section
nav-media.body: Now let's add an image to our presentation. Click the highlighted Media button in the left menu.

media-intro.title: Explore the media library
media-intro.body: Here you can manage, preview, and add images and videos to your presentations. You can also use multiple media files to create slides that play in a loop.

nav-hymns.title: Open the Hymns section
nav-hymns.body: Now let's learn to add hymn lyrics to our presentation. Click the highlighted Hymns button in the left menu.

hymns-intro.title: Explore hymn presentations
hymns-intro.body: You can present hymns in two ways. Normal Mode puts each stanza on a separate slide. Parts Mode keeps all stanzas in one slide. We'll use Parts Mode in this exercise.

nav-countdown.title: Open the Countdown section
nav-countdown.body: Now let's add a countdown to our presentation. Click the highlighted Countdown button in the left menu.

countdown-intro.title: Create a countdown
countdown-intro.body: Here you can set minutes and seconds to add countdowns to your presentations. You can also adjust the countdown's appearance to suit your needs.

nav-screen.title: Open the Screen section
nav-screen.body: Click the highlighted Screen button in the left menu.

screen-intro.title: Screen capture
screen-intro.body: Here you can select a screen or window on your computer and add its image to your presentation. Selecting a screen capture source doesn't start projector output. Since we're in practice mode, I can't demonstrate this in more detail.

nav-calendar.title: Open the Calendar section
nav-calendar.body: Click the highlighted Calendar button in the left menu.

calendar-intro.title: Plan your presentations
calendar-intro.body: Use the calendar to schedule presentations for specific dates and reopen them from their entries when the time comes. This helps you organize preparations for upcoming services and events.

nav-editor.title: Open the Editor section
nav-editor.body: Now let's explore more detailed slide editing tools. Click the highlighted Editor button in the left menu.

editor-intro.title: Explore the Slide Editor
editor-intro.body: In the Slide Editor, you can edit your slides' content and appearance. Now we'll select our sample image, rotate it by 15°, and save the change. Everything will be done only in the practice presentation.

nav-settings.title: Open the Settings section
nav-settings.body: Click the highlighted Settings button in the left menu.

settings-intro.title: Make the app your own
settings-intro.body: Find settings by category or use the search field. You can return to the step-by-step guide from the learning category.

nav-save.title: Return to Presentations
nav-save.body: Now we can save the presentation we've prepared! Click the highlighted Presentations button in the left menu.

bible-source.title: Open the import menu
bible-source.body: Click the highlighted Import XML button. If a source is already open, we'll continue through its management menu.

bible-import.title: Load the sample Bible source
bible-import.body: In the menu that opens, click Import XML. The sample Bible source will load automatically; you don't need to select your own files.

bible-book.title: Choose a book
bible-book.body: Click the highlighted first book in the list of Bible books.

bible-chapter.title: Choose a chapter
bible-chapter.body: Now click the highlighted chapter 1 button. We'll display the verses in that chapter.

bible-verse.title: Choose a verse
bible-verse.body: Click the highlighted sample verse. We'll add your chosen verse to our presentation.

bible-add.title: Add the verse to the presentation
bible-add.body: Click Add to Presentation. A slide will be created automatically for your chosen verse.

media-menu.title: Open the add media menu
media-menu.body: Click the highlighted Add Media button.

media-import.title: Load the sample image
media-import.body: Click Select Image. In this exercise, we'll use a prepared sample image instead of choosing a file from your computer.

media-add.title: Add the image to your presentation
media-add.body: Click the + button below the sample image. The image will be added to your presentation as a new slide.

countdown-duration.title: Set the countdown duration
countdown-duration.body: Enter 2 in the Minutes field. In this exercise, we'll only change the minutes value.

countdown-add.title: Add the countdown to the presentation
countdown-add.body: Click Add to Slide. A two-minute countdown slide will be created. We won't start the timer or live output yet.

save.title: Save your presentation to the library
save.body: Click the blue Save to Library button in the current presentation area. Save to File is a separate action. This exercise saves only to the practice library; your real presentations are unaffected.

add-result.title: Your first slide is ready!
add-result.body: Congratulations, you've created your first slide! You can use slides to add text, images, and much more to your presentation.

delete-result.title: The sample slide was deleted
delete-result.body: The selected sample was removed. Your other slides are retained.

bible-result.title: Your verse slide is ready!
bible-result.body: Great! You've added a Bible verse to your presentation. This is how you can quickly turn verses into slides.

media-result.title: Your image slide is ready!
media-result.body: You've successfully added your image! This is how you can use photos, backgrounds, and other images in your presentations.

countdown-result.title: Your countdown slide is ready!
countdown-result.body: You've created your two-minute countdown! What you see here is only a preview; the countdown hasn't started yet.

save-result.title: Your presentation has been saved!
save-result.body: Congratulations! You've successfully saved your presentation. Whenever you like, you can reopen it from the practice library and continue your work.

hymns-add.title: Add the sample hymn
hymns-add.body: Click the highlighted sample hymn. Its lyrics will be added to your presentation in Parts Mode.

hymns-result.title: Your hymn slide is ready!
hymns-result.body: Congratulations! You've added your first hymn to your presentation. Now you can display the lyrics on a slide and switch between stanzas.

image-select.title: Select your image slide
image-select.body: Now let's edit our image a little. Click the highlighted image slide. We'll make two simple changes using the panel on the right.

image-fit.title: Show the whole image
image-fit.body: Click Fit Inside in the right panel. The entire image will fit into the slide area without being cropped.

image-grayscale.title: Apply grayscale
image-grayscale.body: Set the Grayscale slider to 100%. You can also select the slider and press End.

image-edit-result.title: You've edited your image!
image-edit-result.body: Great! You've fitted the whole image into the frame and applied a grayscale effect. You can see the final version of your image here.

hymns-parts.title: Switch between hymn stanzas
hymns-parts.body: The numbered buttons in the right panel represent the hymn's stanzas. During a presentation, simply click the relevant number to switch to the stanza you want. For now, we're just getting to know this area.

reorder.title: Change the slide order
reorder.body: You can arrange your slides in any order you like. Drag the highlighted sample slide onto the other highlighted slide and drop it. This step will be complete when the order changes.

hymns-font.title: Adjust the hymn text size
hymns-font.body: You can change the size of hymn lyrics using Font Size in the right panel. A higher value makes the text larger, and a lower value makes it smaller. You don't need to change anything in this step.

image-tools.title: How can you edit images?
image-tools.body: You can quickly edit images using the properties panel on the right. For more detailed options, use the Slide Editor opened by the pencil icon. You can also access video editing options there.

hymns-online.title: Online hymns
hymns-online.body: The Online Hymns button gives you access to online hymn sources, where you can find the hymns you want and add them to your library.

hymns-author.title: Show author information
hymns-author.body: Show Author determines whether the author's name appears on the slide alongside the hymn lyrics. This feature is available for hymns that include author information.

hymns-mode.title: How does Parts Mode work?
hymns-mode.body: Parts Mode keeps all the hymn's stanzas in a single slide. During a presentation, you can switch between stanzas using the numbered buttons in the right panel.

phone-controls.title: Phone Control
phone-controls.body: Use the Phone Control button in the main app's top toolbar to manage your presentation from your phone. The computer running the presentation and your phone must be connected to the same network!

editor-select.title: Select the image
editor-select.body: Click the highlighted sample image. Editing options for your selected image will open in the right panel.

editor-rotate.title: Rotate the image
editor-rotate.body: Enter 15 in the Rotation field in the right panel. You can see how the image rotates on the slide.

editor-save.title: Save your changes
editor-save.body: We've finished editing! Now click Save. This step will be complete once your changes have been saved to the presentation.

editor-result.title: Your edit has been saved!
editor-result.body: Great! You've selected the image, rotated it by 15°, and saved your change. You can see the final version of your slide here.
